**The five smallest countries by land area (≈ 0.44 – 61 km²)**  

| Country | Current head of government (or head of state) | Native language(s) |
|---------|----------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| Vatican City | **Pope Francis** (no separate prime‑minister; the Pope serves as the head of state and government) | **Spanish** (Pope Francis was born in Argentina; Spanish is his mother‑tongue) |
| Monaco | **Pierre Dartout** – Minister of State (the chief executive of Monaco) | **French** (French is his native language; he was born in France) |
| Nauru | **Marcus Stephen** – Prime Minister | **Nauruan** (he grew up speaking Nauruan; English is also official, but his mother‑tongue is Nauruan) |
| Tuvalu | **Kausea Natano** – Prime Minister | **Tuvaluan** (his native language; English is also an official language) |
| San Marino | **Captains Regent** (joint heads of state & government; currently **Gian Marco Antonioli** and **Lucia Balsimelli**) | **Italian** (the official language of San Marino; both Captains Regent are native Italian speakers) |

> **Note:**  
> * Vatican City has no prime minister; the Pope is the sole head of state and government.  
> * San Marino’s system is unique: the Captains Regent serve as joint heads of state and government, not a single prime minister.  
> * The native languages listed are the mother tongues of the individuals who currently hold the highest executive office in each country.
